description.en: Xenacanthus decheni inspired whole living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Lankester1909 named whole skeleton and outline; Hampe2003 read notes identify Lower Permian Bohemia type species. Not a single specimen scan. Body proportions inferred; nominal 1m, color, fin thickness and pose artistic. Museum text supports long dorsal ribbon and rear-head spine; refused museum illustration not used. No exact fossil dimensions or modern local PDF claim.
